summary: DEPT. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 73% of its 11 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 7 about growth or hiring; 6 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam-rooted digital and marketing agency with 4,000+ specialists; 20 mostly English jobs in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, including internships, and an IND sponsor.

culture.text: Values are 'Better together, Relentlessly curious, Get sh*t done', with employee communities DEPT/PRIDE, DEPT/MOSAIC and DEPT/WOMEN.
Half tech, half marketing, working for clients like Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay and OpenAI.
Staff study marketing, computer science, communication and design, from schools including University of Mumbai, Buenos Aires, UvA and Amsterdam UAS.
Its 20 jobs are in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, mostly marketing and communications, including 4 internships.

open.text: Dept Creative & Media B.V. and Dept Holding B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
80% of its 20 jobs here don't require Dutch, though none mention visa support.

growth.text: Now has 4,000+ specialists, with about 4,804 people on LinkedIn.
Developing a multi-year brand concept for Dutch insurer Univé.

worth_knowing.text: Certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.
Its deputy CFO expanded outsourcing rather than waiting for AI to take over that work.
